syncErrors.generic: The bank did not complete the request. Bursar will try again at the next sync.
syncErrors.EXPIRED_SESSION: The bank consent has expired. Renew it to resume syncing.
syncErrors.REVOKED_SESSION: The bank consent was revoked. Renew it to resume syncing.
syncErrors.CLOSED_SESSION: The bank closed the consent. Renew it to resume syncing.
syncErrors.SESSION_DOES_NOT_EXIST: The bank no longer recognises the consent. Renew it to resume syncing.
syncErrors.WRONG_SESSION_STATUS: The bank consent is not active. Renew it to resume syncing.
syncErrors.ACCOUNT_DOES_NOT_EXIST: The bank no longer shows this account.
syncErrors.ASPSP_ACCOUNT_NOT_ACCESSIBLE: The bank does not allow access to this account right now.

syncErrors.ASPSP_RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: The bank limits how often Bursar can read this account.
syncErrors.PAGINATION_LOOP: The bank returned the same page of transactions twice, so the sync was stopped.
syncErrors.ACCESS_DENIED: The bank refused access to the account data.
syncErrors.PSU_HEADER_NOT_PROVIDED: The bank asked for details about the request that were not sent.
syncErrors.PSU_HEADER_INVALID: The bank rejected the request details.
syncErrors.INVALID_PROVIDER_DATA: The bank sent data Bursar cannot read, so the sync was stopped.

syncErrors.no_provider_uid: The bank did not provide an identifier for this account. Renew the consent.
syncErrors.sync_in_progress: A sync is already running for this account.
syncErrors.nothing_to_sync: There is no active account to sync.

alerts.consentExpiringDetail: Renew it before it ends, or Bursar stops reading this bank.

alerts.connectionErrorDetail: The bank ended the consent. Renew it, or disconnect the bank.

hint.error: The connection to the bank reports an error. Renew the consent; if the problem stays, try again later.

accounts.subtitle: The banks linked to Bursar, the accounts they expose and the state of each consent.
accounts.allUpdated: All good: every account was updated today.

loadError.title: Accounts could not be loaded
loadError.body: Check your connection and try again. Nothing was changed.

empty.title: No bank connected yet
empty.body: Bursar only reads balances and transactions from your bank. It cannot make payments or move money, and you can disconnect at any time.

noConnections.title: No active connections
noConnections.body: Only disconnected accounts are left, listed below.

noAccounts.title: No accounts on this connection
noAccounts.body: The bank did not share any account. Renew the consent and select the accounts you want to see.

row.netTitle: Inflows minus outflows over the last 30 days
row.syncFailedTitle: The last attempt failed {{when}}. The next scheduled sync will try again.

status.disabledTitle: The account is not synced and is left out of the totals.
status.unavailableTitle: The bank no longer exposes this account. Renewing the consent may bring it back.

blocked.disabled: The account is disabled. Enable it to sync.
blocked.unavailable: The bank no longer exposes this account.
blocked.rateLimited: The bank is limiting requests for this account. Try again {{when}}.
blocked.running: A sync of this account is already running.

disable.title: Disable {{name}}?
disable.body: {{name}} stops syncing and is left out of your totals and transaction lists. Nothing is deleted, and you can enable it again at any time.

disconnect.title: Disconnect {{bank}}?
disconnect.lead: Bursar stops reading data from this bank. This cannot be undone, but you can connect the bank again later.
disconnect.failed: What will be removed could not be worked out.
disconnect.accounts_one: {{count}} account moves to “Disconnected accounts” and stops syncing
disconnect.accounts_other: {{count}} accounts move to “Disconnected accounts” and stop syncing
disconnect.transactions_one: {{n}} transaction stays in Bursar until you purge it
disconnect.transactions_other: {{n}} transactions stay in Bursar until you purge them
disconnect.noTransactions: There are no transactions to keep.
disconnect.outro: Bursar also asks the bank to close the access it was given. If you connect the bank again, accounts that still hold their transactions are re-attached.

removed.title: Disconnected accounts
removed.description: These accounts no longer sync. Their transactions stay in Bursar until you purge them.

purge.title: Purge the transactions of {{name}}?
purge.body_one: {{n}} transaction, the balances and the sync history of this account will be deleted from Bursar. This cannot be undone. Your bank is not affected.
purge.body_other: {{n}} transactions, the balances and the sync history of this account will be deleted from Bursar. This cannot be undone. Your bank is not affected.
purge.bodyEmpty: {{name}} has no transactions left. The account, its balances and its sync history will be deleted. This cannot be undone.

toast.renamedDetail: “{{name}}” is now the name shown across Bursar.
toast.renamedReset: The default name is shown again.

toast.enabledDetail: {{name}} is back in the totals and syncs with the next scheduled sync.

toast.syncStartedConnection_one: Reading {{count}} account at {{bank}}. New transactions appear in about a minute.
toast.syncStartedConnection_other: Reading {{count}} accounts at {{bank}}. New transactions appear in about a minute.

toast.disconnectedDetail_other: {{bank}} is disconnected. {{count}} accounts moved to “Disconnected accounts” and their transactions are still here.
toast.purgedDetail_one: {{n}} transaction of {{name}} was deleted from Bursar.
toast.purgedDetail_other: {{n}} transactions of {{name}} were deleted from Bursar.
